ios.desc:
Chinese characters are not just random shapes -  learn 1000 characters in months by understanding their structure and origin! Through visual breakdowns and engaging stories, Hanly helps you develop an intuitive grasp of Chinese characters and to efficiently remember them. Hanly starts with simple components and quickly builds up to complex characters, while focusing on the most frequently used vocabulary. 

CARDS THAT MAKE CHARACTERS COME ALIVE

Etymology, memorable illustrations, mnemonics: we will provide the most helpful information to get a character to come alive in your imagination and stick in your memory for good.


INTUITIVE INTERACTIVE UI

Play with characters like they’re Lego blocks! Explore radicals, components, compound words, and character relationships - all just one click away!


CAREFULLY OPTIMIZED LEARNING PROGRESSION

Start with simple building blocks and naturally progress to complex characters. Our carefully designed levels introduce the most frequent characters early while maintaining coherent, meaningful themes. 


EXTENSIVE CHARACTER DICTIONARY & SEARCH

Search by character, pinyin or meaning to find: 
- Character meanings and pronunciations 
- Usage in compound words and characters 
- Frequency and HSK level 
- Radical forms
- Stroke order animations
- Character evolution history 


SPACED REPETITION ENGINE INTEGRATED WITH THE UI

Built-in spaced repetition helps you review characters at the perfect time, with review schedule optimized for how well you know a given character. Character progress is deeply integrated with the UI, so that you can spot the characters you are learning on any page.


AND MANY MORE FEATURES!
- Detailed learning statistics 
- Character etymology stories & fun facts
- Explore characters & radicals sorted by their frequency
- Personal note-taking system 
- Easily mark characters you already know


Terms of use: https://www.hanlyapp.com/terms-of-use

Privacy policy: https://www.hanlyapp.com/privacy-policy

Contact us:
We’d love to hear from your feedback about Hanly! Please send us an email with your thoughts and suggestions at tutu@hanlyapp.com

show_hn.title: Show HN: Hanly – Learning Chinese characters reimagined

quotes.text:
Learning Chinese characters is unreasonably hard and is arguably the main reason why most people give up on the language. The existing apps mostly just show you a character and ask you to “remember” these random-looking complex shapes.

Frustrated with this during my own learning journey, I decided to build Hanly. The core idea: there is deep tree-like structure to Chinese characters, and Hanly teaches them by making you climb up this hierarchy, so that at every step you either learn a very basic building block or combine already known building blocks. This approach makes learning feel more like playing with LEGOs rather than memorizing random shapes.

I left a link for iOS but the app is also available on Android (currently completely free on both platforms): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.hanly.chinese

It’s the first app I ever built and any feedback is very appreciated!
